rules.name: Phishing Link Detection
rules.description: Detect credential harvesting links in email via URL reputation
rules.query: SELECT "siem_initial_access_initial_access_127", "data__json.message" FROM "oci_monitoring_metricexplorer_metrics" WHERE "compartmentId" = '$COMPARTMENT_ID' AND "namespace" = 'OciLoggingService' AND ("data__json.message" LIKE '%phishing%' OR "data__json.message" LIKE '%link%') AND "value" > 0
